invariants.description: second law: every reaction runs down its affinity, v A >= 0, so P_diss >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(v_FBPASE*A_FBPASE >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_FBPASE).max()*np.abs(A_FBPASE).max()) and np.all(v_G6PASE*A_G6PASE >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_G6PASE).max()*np.abs(A_G6PASE).max()) and np.all(v_GK*A_GK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_GK).max()*np.abs(A_GK).max()) and np.all(v_G3PDH*A_G3PDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_G3PDH).max()*np.abs(A_G3PDH).max()) and np.all(P_diss >= -1e-9*np.abs(P_diss).max())

invariants.description: the ports report each chemostat's net production: j_glc = v_G6PASE, j_F6P = v_FBPASE, j_glycerol = -v_GK, j_DHAP = v_G3PDH (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_glc, v_G6PASE, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_F6P, v_FBPASE, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_glycerol, -v_GK, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_DHAP, v_G3PDH, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

bc_sweep.rationale: glycerol from trace to a fat-mobilising load; NADH/NAD+ from respiring to fermenting; the sugar phosphates and glucose over an order of magnitude
